note: Veteran-owned wooded park with cabins and rental houses just north of Roaring River State Park near Cassville; pool (Memorial Day to Labor Day), game room and playground. The RV loop sits behind the cabins, off State Hwy 112. --Claude
summary: Operator site + park map: confirmed $40 (2025 page), 30/50A full hookups, 40-ft max, pull-throughs; added count 22 (14 nightly pull-throughs + 8 annual back-ins), dump/laundry/wifi, ResOnTheWeb booking link and cancellation terms; note cleaned. Passes every private gate; not waterfront stands.
flags: Private gates: rate $40/night + tax (operator RV page, modified 2025-04-09); no gateway within 40 km (Branson 56 km); family has not stayed. Presence: working site with phone (417) 847-0291 and online booking. Google Maps 4.7 (187 reviews); RV Life 5 stars (14 reviews), $$, avg_rate $33. Good Sam status unknown (not stored).

Long-stay: markets 'by the night, week, or month', but the operator says 'We are NOT a residential or long-term park', caps monthly stays at 2 months, and 14 of its 22 RV sites (the pull-throughs) are sold nightly; the 8 back-ins are annual. All five tests pass (price $40; nightly rate posted with an engine; no minimum; 14 of 22 nightly; not a home community).
Booking engine (resontheweb.com HotelCode=21598) answered plain HTTP with a Java error page, so a dated 2026 engine quote was not read; the $40 rests on the operator's RV page.

Pin 36.6181,-93.8469 sits at the office/cabins by Hwy 112; the RV herringbone loop centres about 150 m ESE (~36.6174,-93.8455) on imagery. Under the 250 m threshold, so no move proposed. Google's pin 36.6189,-93.8473 is the office.
Waterfront: no water near the RV loop (wooded hillside); 'not waterfront' stands.
